dataflowSinks.script:
sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	input(
		{CRIS No} as integer,
		Accession as string,
		{Ref Src} as string,
		Site as string,
		{Request Date} as date,
		{Event Date} as date,
		{Event Time} as string,
		{On Call} as string,
		PT as string,
		Examination as string,
		{Exam Name} as string,
		Room as string,
		{Start Time} as string,
		{End Time} as string,
		{Exam Key} as integer,
		{Event Key} as integer,
		{Status Code} as string,
		{Booked Date} as timestamp,
		{Booked Time} as string,
		{Creation Date} as timestamp,
		Attended as string,
		Urg as string,
		Modality as string,
		{No of Proc} as integer,
		{Planned Appointment Date} as timestamp,
		{Date First Verified} as timestamp,
		{Time First Verified} as string,
		{Was Planned} as string,
		{Was Scheduled} as string,
		{Was Waiting} as string,
		{Stat Date} as timestamp,
		{Reported By} as string,
		Rank as integer,
		{Age At Event} as string,
		{Status Code.2} as string,
		{Status Date.1} as timestamp,
		{Status Time} as string,
		Modality2 as string,
		{Trust Name} as string,
		Patient_Type as string,
		{Tat Type} as string,
		{Activity.1} as integer,
		{Count of Activty_Demand for Activity.1} as long,
		{ExamSite Code} as string
	),
	deletable:false,
	insertable:true,
	updateable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	truncate:true,
	format: 'table',
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	errorHandlingOption: 'stopOnFirstError') ~> UserQueryAzureSqlCOREStageStep2

      ,[CoreUpdateValue]

      ,[CoreUpdateValue]

      ,[CoreUpdateValue]

SELECT [TableName]
      ,[CoreUpdateValue]

SELECT [TableName]
      ,[CoreUpdateValue]
  FROM [dev].[CoreUpdatetable]

SELECT [TableName]
      ,[CoreUpdateValue]
  FROM [dev].[CoreUpdatetable]
  Where [TableName] = 'REPO_META'

      ,[CoreUpdateValue]
  FROM [dev].[CoreUpdatetable]
  Where [TableName] = 'APDNA'

      ,[CoreUpdateValue]
  FROM [dev].[CoreUpdatetable]
  Where [TableName] = 'ptl'

Select *
	  ,[WEEK_0_LESSTHAN_1]+[WEEK_1_LESSTHAN_2]+[WEEK_2_LESSTHAN_3]+[WEEK_3_LESSTHAN_4]+[WEEK_4_LESSTHAN_5]+[WEEK_5_LESSTHAN_6]+[WEEK_6_LESSTHAN_7]+[WEEK_7_LESSTHAN_8]+[WEEK_8_LESSTHAN_9]+[WEEK_9_LESSTHAN_10]+[WEEK_10_LESSTHAN_11]+[WEEK_11_LESSTHAN_12]+[WEEK_12_LESSTHAN_13]+[WEEKS_13PLUS] as [Calc_total_WL]
	  ,[WEEK_6_LESSTHAN_7] + [WEEK_7_LESSTHAN_8]+ [WEEK_8_LESSTHAN_9]+ [WEEK_9_LESSTHAN_10] + [WEEK_10_LESSTHAN_11] + [WEEK_11_LESSTHAN_12] + [WEEK_12_LESSTHAN_13] + [WEEKs_13PLUS] as [Over 6 Weeks]
	  ,[WEEK_0_LESSTHAN_1] + [WEEK_1_LESSTHAN_2]+ [WEEK_2_LESSTHAN_3]+ [WEEK_3_LESSTHAN_4] + [WEEK_4_LESSTHAN_5] + [WEEK_5_LESSTHAN_6] as [Under 6 Weeks]
	  ,Cast(Case when [TOTAL_WL] <> 0 then cast(([WEEK_0_LESSTHAN_1] + [WEEK_1_LESSTHAN_2]+ [WEEK_2_LESSTHAN_3]+ [WEEK_3_LESSTHAN_4] + [WEEK_4_LESSTHAN_5] + [WEEK_5_LESSTHAN_6]) as float)/Cast([WEEK_0_LESSTHAN_1]+[WEEK_1_LESSTHAN_2]+[WEEK_2_LESSTHAN_3]+[WEEK_3_LESSTHAN_4]+[WEEK_4_LESSTHAN_5]+[WEEK_5_LESSTHAN_6]+[WEEK_6_LESSTHAN_7]+[WEEK_7_LESSTHAN_8]+[WEEK_8_LESSTHAN_9]+[WEEK_9_LESSTHAN_10]+[WEEK_10_LESSTHAN_11]+[WEEK_11_LESSTHAN_12]+[WEEK_12_LESSTHAN_13]+[WEEKS_13PLUS] as float) else 0 end as float) as percentage
From (SELECT [PROVIDER_ORG_CODE]
      ,[PROVIDER_ORG_NAME]
      ,[DIAGNOSTIC_TESTS_SORT_ORDER]
      ,[DIAGNOSTIC_TESTS]
      ,SUM([WEEK_0_LESSTHAN_1]) as [WEEK_0_LESSTHAN_1]
      ,SUM([WEEK_1_LESSTHAN_2]) as [WEEK_1_LESSTHAN_2]
      ,SUM([WEEK_2_LESSTHAN_3]) as [WEEK_2_LESSTHAN_3]
      ,SUM([WEEK_3_LESSTHAN_4]) as [WEEK_3_LESSTHAN_4]
      ,SUM([WEEK_4_LESSTHAN_5]) as [WEEK_4_LESSTHAN_5]
      ,SUM([WEEK_5_LESSTHAN_6]) as [WEEK_5_LESSTHAN_6]
      ,SUM([WEEK_6_LESSTHAN_7]) as [WEEK_6_LESSTHAN_7]
      ,SUM([WEEK_7_LESSTHAN_8]) as [WEEK_7_LESSTHAN_8]
      ,SUM([WEEK_8_LESSTHAN_9]) as [WEEK_8_LESSTHAN_9]
      ,SUM([WEEK_9_LESSTHAN_10]) as [WEEK_9_LESSTHAN_10]
      ,SUM([WEEK_10_LESSTHAN_11]) as [WEEK_10_LESSTHAN_11]
      ,SUM([WEEK_11_LESSTHAN_12]) as [WEEK_11_LESSTHAN_12]
      ,SUM([WEEK_12_LESSTHAN_13]) as [WEEK_12_LESSTHAN_13]
      ,SUM([WEEKS_13PLUS]) as [WEEKS_13PLUS]
      ,SUM([TOTAL_WL]) as [TOTAL_WL]
      ,SUM([WAITING_LIST_ACTIVITY]) as [WAITING_LIST_ACTIVITY]
      ,SUM([PLANNED_ACTIVITY]) as [PLANNED_ACTIVITY]
      ,SUM([UNSCHEDULED_ACTIVITY]) as [UNSCHEDULED_ACTIVITY]
      ,SUM([TOTAL_ACTIVITY]) as [TOTAL_ACTIVITY]
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_MONTH]
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_YEAR]
	  ,cast(CONCAT('01','/',[Z_SNAPSHOT_MONTH],'/',[Z_SNAPSHOT_YEAR]) as date) as SnapShotDate
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_FISCAL_MONTH]
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_FISCAL_YEAR]
      ,[Z_LATEST_SNAPSHOT]
      ,[z_load_date]
      ,[z_snapshot_filename]
    FROM [Unify].[NAT_DM01]
  Where PROVIDER_PARENT_ORG_CODE in ('Q75','Qyg')
  and Z_SNAPSHOT_YEAR >=2019
  Group by [PROVIDER_ORG_CODE]
      ,[PROVIDER_ORG_NAME]
      ,[DIAGNOSTIC_TESTS_SORT_ORDER]
      ,[DIAGNOSTIC_TESTS]
	  ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_MONTH]
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_YEAR]
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_FISCAL_MONTH]
      ,[Z_SNAPSHOT_FISCAL_YEAR]
      ,[Z_LATEST_SNAPSHOT]
	  ,[z_load_date]
      ,[z_snapshot_filename]) as Base

SELECT [Trust ID]
		,[Modality ID]
      ,[Tat Type ID]
	  ,[Exam ID]
      ,[Patient Type ID]
	  ,[Exam Urgency]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=12 and [Image-Report Hours]<=4 then 1
			when [Tat Type ID]=11 and [Image-Report Hours]<=12 then 1 
			else null end) as [Image-Report 4H/12H Pass]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=12 or [Tat Type ID]=11 then 1 
			else null end) as [Image-Report 4H/12H Report]
	  ,sum(Case when ([Tat Type ID]=12 or [Tat Type ID]=8)  and [Image-Report Hours]<=4 then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 4H Pass]
	  ,sum(Case when ([Tat Type ID]=12 or [Tat Type ID]=8) then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 4H Report]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=11  and [Image-Report Hours]<=12 then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 12H Pass]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=11  then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 12H Report]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=3  and [Image-Report Hours]<=24 then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 24H Pass]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=3  then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 24H Report]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=7  and [Image-Report Days]<=28 then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 28D Pass]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=7   then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 28D Report]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=6  and [Image-Report Days]<=3 then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 3D Pass]
	 ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=6  then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 3D Report]
	  ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=9  and [Image-Report Days]<=7 then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 7D Pass]
	 ,sum(Case when [Tat Type ID]=9  then 1
			else null end) as [Image-Report 7D Report]
	  ,[Report Year Only]
      ,[Report Month Number Only]
      ,[Month First Verified]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2]
  Where [Datetime First Verified] is not null
  Group by [Trust ID],[Modality ID]
      ,[Tat Type ID]
	  ,[Exam ID]
      ,[Patient Type ID]
	  ,[Exam Urgency]
	  ,[Report Year Only]
      ,[Report Month Number Only]
      ,[Month First Verified]

SELECT [Trust ID]
	,[Modality ID]
      ,[Patient Type ID]
	  ,[Report Year Only]
      ,[Report Month Number Only]
      ,[Month First Verified]
	  ,[Date First Verified]
	  ,Avg([Request-Report Hours]) as [Avg Request-Report Hours]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2]
  Where [Datetime First Verified] is not null
  and [Patient Type ID]=4
  and [Request-Report Hours] >0
  Group by [Trust ID]
	,[Modality ID]
      ,[Patient Type ID]
	  ,[Report Year Only]
      ,[Report Month Number Only]
      ,[Month First Verified]
	  ,[Date First Verified]

SELECT [Modality ID]
      ,[Status ID]
      ,[Trust ID]
      ,Sum(Case when [Activity]=0 then 1 else 0 end) as Backlog
	  ,Sum([Activity]) as Activity
      ,[Request Date]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2]
  Group by [Modality ID]
      ,[Status ID]
      ,[Trust ID]
      ,[Request Date]

select Case 
	When isnumeric(b.[Description])=1  then b.[Trust_ID_2]
	else a.[Trust ID]
	end [Trust ID]
    ,[Updated Modality] as [Modality ID]
    ,Case 
	When isnumeric(b.[Description])=1  then b.[Description]
	else a.[Exam Room ID]
	end as [Exam Room ID]
    ,[Event Date]
    ,[Event Hour]
    ,Sum([Body Parts Activity]) as [Sum]
    ,Sum(case when [Updated Modality] = 2 then [Body Parts Activity] else 0 end) as [Sum CT]
    ,Sum(case when [Updated Modality] = 9 then [Body Parts Activity] else 0 end) as [Sum MRI]
    ,Sum(case when [Updated Modality] = 12 then [Body Parts Activity] else 0 end) as [Sum NOUS]
    ,Sum(case when [Updated Modality] = 4 then [Body Parts Activity] else 0 end) as [Sum DEXA]
	,case when [Updated Modality]= 2 then Sum([Body Parts Activity])-1 else Sum([Body Parts Activity]) end as ConForm2
FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2] as a
Left Join dev.Exam_Site_2 as b on a.[Exam Room ID]=b.[Exam room ID]
Where [Event Date]>='2024-06-01'
--and [Event Hour] between 8 and 19
and a.[Updated Modality] = b.[Modality_ID]
and a.[Exam Room ID] not in (795,3,11,13,20,32,37,50,112,142,187,192,194,198,199,208,209,258,261,262,294,296,298,304,314,318,342,374,411,429,448,472,478,479,479,480,482,483,484,484,499,500,508,516,517,552,553,556,557,558,560,561,562,564,570,571,583,589,590,601,604,651,683,692,693,697,709,719,734,779,780,797,848,887,891,935,936,938,939,950,964,977,999,1008,1030,1057,1061,1062,1067,1072,1074,1082,1087,1147
)
group by Case 
	When isnumeric(b.[Description])=1  then b.[Trust_ID_2]
	else a.[Trust ID]
	end
    ,[Updated Modality]
    ,Case 
	When isnumeric(b.[Description])=1  then b.[Description]
	else a.[Exam Room ID]
	end
    ,[Event Date]
    ,[Event Hour]

SELECT [Event Key]
	,[Request Date]
	,[Event Date]
	,[Request-Image Days]
	,[Date First Verified]
	,[Image-Report Days]
	,Activity
	,[Trust ID]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2]
  Where [Exam ID]=1465 and [Planned Appointment Date] is null and [Was Planned]='n'

select [Event Key]
,left(Accession,3) as trust
,Count([Event Key]) as [partially reported exams]
,[Site]
,[Request Date]
,[Event Date]
,[PT]
,[Examination]
,[Room]
,[Exam Key]
,[Modality]
FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE]
where [Event Key] in(
SELECT [Event Key]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE]
  where [Date First Verified] is null
  ) and [Event Key] in(
SELECT [Event Key]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE]
  where [Date First Verified] is not null)
 and [Date First Verified] is null
 and Attended = 'Y'
 group by  [Event Key],left(Accession,3),[Site],[Request Date]
      ,[Event Date],[PT],[Examination],[Room],[Exam Key],[Modality]
 order by [Event Key]

SELECT 
	  CAST(FORMAT([Request Date], 'yyyy-MM-01') AS DATE) AS StartOfMonth
      ,[Trust ID]
      ,[Updated Modality]
	  ,[Patient Type ID]
      ,[Referral Source ID]
	  ,[Exam ID]
	  ,Count([Request-Image Days]) as [Count]
      ,Avg([Request-Image Days]) as [Avg Request-Image Days]
      ,Avg([Request-Image Hours])  as [Avg Request-Image Hours]
       FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2]
	   Where [Request Date] is not null
	   and [Request Year Only]>2020
	   and [Was Planned]='N' 
	   and [Patient Type ID] in (1,3,4,6)
	   and [Updated Modality] in (2,4,8,9,12,15)
	   Group by   CAST(FORMAT([Request Date], 'yyyy-MM-01') AS DATE)
	  ,[Was Planned]
      ,[Patient Type ID]
      ,[Updated Modality]
      ,[Trust ID]
      ,[Referral Source ID] 
	  ,[Exam ID]
	  order by CAST(FORMAT([Request Date], 'yyyy-MM-01') AS DATE),[Trust ID],[Referral Source ID]

SELECT a.[Request Date] as [Request Date]
,e.[Trust Name Group2] as [Examinaion Trust]
,d.[Trust Name Group2] as [Referral Trust_Name]
,a.[Referral Source ID]
,a.[Patient Type ID]
,a.[Updated Modality]
,a.[Status ID]
,a.[exam ID]
, [Exam Key]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2] as a
  Left Join [dev].[Referral Source] as b on a.[Referral Source ID]=b.[Referral Source ID]
  Left Join [dev].[Patient Type] as c on a.[Patient Type ID]=c.[Patient Type ID]
  Left Join [dev].[Trust Unique] as d on LEFT(b.[Referral Source],3)=d.[Trust Name Group] 
  Left Join [dev].[Trust Unique] as e on LEFT(a.[ExamSite Code],3)=e.[Trust Name Group]
  Where e.[Trust Name Group2]<> d.[Trust Name Group2]
  and e.[Trust Name Group2] is not null
  and Datediff(year,a.[Request Date],Getdate()) <=5

SELECT Dateadd(Month,-1,dateadd(day,1,EOMONTH(a.[Request Date]))) as [Request Month]
	  ,d.[Trust Name Group2]
      ,c.[Patient_Type]
      ,e.[Modality2]
      ,f.[Status Code]
      ,b.[Referral Source]
	  ,Count(f.[Status Code]) as [Count]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2] as a
  Left Join [dev].[Referral Source] as b on a.[Referral Source ID]=b.[Referral Source ID]
  Left Join [dev].[Patient Type] as c on a.[Patient Type ID]=c.[Patient Type ID]
  Left Join [dev].[Trust Unique] as d on a.[Trust ID]=d.[Trust ID]
  Left Join [dev].[Modality] as e on a.[Updated Modality]=e.[Modality ID]
  Left Join [dev].[Status] as f on a.[Status ID]=f.[Status ID]
  Where d.[Trust Name Group2] is not null
  and Datediff(year,a.[Request Date],Getdate()) <=5
  Group by Dateadd(Month,-1,dateadd(day,1,EOMONTH(a.[Request Date])))
      ,d.[Trust Name Group2]
 ,c.[Patient_Type]
      ,e.[Modality2]
      ,f.[Status Code]
      ,b.[Referral Source]

SELECT a.[CRIS No]
      ,a.[Accession] as [Accession 1]
	  ,b.[Accession] as [Accession 2]
	  ,a.[Exam ID]	 
	  ,d.[Trust Name Group2] as [Trust Name Group2]
	  ,e.[Trust Name Group2] as [Trust Name Group2 2]
	  ,a.[Event Date] as [Event Date 1]
	  ,b.[Event Date] as [Event Date 2]
	  ,DATEDIFF(day,a.[Event Date],b.[Event Date]) as Diff
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2] as a
  inner Join (
  SELECT [CRIS No]
      ,[Accession]
      ,[Request Date]
	  ,[Event Date]
	  ,[Exam ID]
	  ,[Trust ID]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2]
  where [CRIS No] in (SELECT [CRIS No] FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2] GROUP BY [CRIS No] HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
    and [Request Date] >='12/31/2022') as b on a.[CRIS No]=b.[CRIS No] and a.[Trust ID]<>b.[Trust ID] and a.[Exam ID]=b.[Exam ID] and a.[Event Date]<=b.[Event Date] and DATEDIFF(day,a.[Event Date],b.[Event Date]) between -62 and 62
    Left Join [dev].[Trust Unique] as d on a.[Trust ID]=d.[Trust ID]
	Left Join [dev].[Trust Unique] as e on b.[Trust ID]=e.[Trust ID]
	Left Join [dev].[Exam] as c on a.[Exam ID]=c.[Exam ID]
  where Datediff(year,a.[Request Date],Getdate()) <=3
  and a.[Event Date] <= GETDATE() and b.[Event Date] <= GETDATE()

select [Trust ID]
    ,[Updated Modality] as [Modality ID]
    ,0 as [Exam Room ID]
    ,[Event Date]
    ,[Event Hour]
    ,Avg(cast([Sum] as float)) as [Sum]
    ,Avg(cast([Sum CT] as float))as[Sum CT]
    ,Avg(cast([Sum MRI] as float))as[Sum MRI]
    ,Avg(cast([Sum NOUS] as float))as[Sum NOUS]
    ,Avg(cast([Sum DEXA] as float))as[Sum DEXA]
	,Avg(cast(ConForm2 as float)) as ConForm2
	From(select 0 as [Trust ID]
	,[Updated Modality]
    ,Case 
	When isnumeric(b.[Description])=1  then b.[Description]
	else a.[Exam Room ID]
	end as [Exam Room ID]
    ,[Event Date]
    ,[Event Hour]
    ,Sum([Body Parts Activity]) as [Sum]
    ,Sum(case when [Updated Modality] = 2 then [Body Parts Activity] else 0 end) as [Sum CT]
    ,Sum(case when [Updated Modality] = 9 then [Body Parts Activity] else 0 end) as [Sum MRI]
    ,Sum(case when [Updated Modality] = 12 then [Body Parts Activity] else 0 end) as [Sum NOUS]
    ,Sum(case when [Updated Modality] = 4 then [Body Parts Activity] else 0 end) as [Sum DEXA]
	,case when [Updated Modality]= 2 then Sum([Body Parts Activity])-1 else Sum([Body Parts Activity]) end as ConForm2
FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2] as a
Left Join dev.Exam_Site_2 as b on a.[Exam Room ID]=b.[Exam room ID]
Where [Event Date]>='2024-06-01'
--and [Event Hour] between 8 and 19
and a.[Updated Modality] = b.[Modality_ID]
and a.[Exam Room ID] not in (795,3,11,13,20,32,37,50,112,142,187,192,194,198,199,208,209,258,261,262,294,296,298,304,314,318,342,374,411,429,448,472,478,479,479,480,482,483,484,484,499,500,508,516,517,552,553,556,557,558,560,561,562,564,570,571,583,589,590,601,604,651,683,692,693,697,709,719,734,779,780,797,848,887,891,935,936,938,939,950,964,977,999,1008,1030,1057,1061,1062,1067,1072,1074,1082,1087,1147
)
group by [Updated Modality]
    ,Case 
	When isnumeric(b.[Description])=1  then b.[Description]
	else a.[Exam Room ID]
	end
    ,[Event Date]
    ,[Event Hour]) as CAMRIN
group by
[Trust ID]
    ,[Updated Modality]
    ,[Event Date]
    ,[Event Hour]
Order by     [Modality ID]
    ,[Event Date]
    ,[Event Hour]

Select distinct a.[Event Year Only] as Year -- DID010,HRE010,CCU050,IRE031,IRE032,,IRE034
, a.[Event Month Number Only] as Month
, Datefromparts(a.[Event Year Only],a.[Event Month Number Only],01) as Date
, b.[Trust Name Group2] as Trust
, a.[Exam Urgency]
, f.[Patient_Type]
, c.Tests --DID010
, d.Reports
, e.Referral
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2] as a
  Left join [dev].[Trust Unique] as b on a.[Trust ID]=b.[Trust ID]
  Left join [dev].[Patient Type] as f on a.[Patient Type ID]=f.[Patient Type ID]
  left join (select [Event Year Only] , [Event Month Number Only]  ,[Trust ID],[Exam Urgency],[Patient Type ID], Count(Distinct([Exam Key])) as Tests    FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2] Where [Event Date]          is not null and [Exam Attended]='Y' Group by [Event Month Number Only], [Event Year Only],[Trust ID],[Exam Urgency],[Patient Type ID]) as c on a.[Event Year Only]=c.[Event Year Only]   and a.[Event Month Number Only]=c.[Event Month Number Only]   and a.[Trust ID]=c.[Trust ID] and a.[Exam Urgency]=c.[Exam Urgency] and a.[Patient Type ID]=c.[Patient Type ID]
  left join (select [Report Year Only], [Report Month Number Only] ,[Trust ID],[Exam Urgency],[Patient Type ID], Count(Distinct([Exam Key])) as Reports  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2] Where [Date First Verified] is not null                         Group by [Report Month Number Only], [Report Year Only],[Trust ID],[Exam Urgency],[Patient Type ID])                       as d on a.[Event Year Only]=d.[Report Year Only]  and a.[Event Month Number Only]=d.[Report Month Number Only]  and a.[Trust ID]=d.[Trust ID] and a.[Exam Urgency]=d.[Exam Urgency] and a.[Patient Type ID]=d.[Patient Type ID]
  left join (select [Request Year Only],[Request Month Number Only],[Trust ID],[Exam Urgency],[Patient Type ID], Count(Distinct([Exam Key])) as Referral FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2]                                                                 Group by [Request Month Number Only], [Request Year Only],[Trust ID],[Exam Urgency],[Patient Type ID])                    as e on a.[Event Year Only]=e.[Request Year Only] and a.[Event Month Number Only]=e.[Request Month Number Only] and a.[Trust ID]=e.[Trust ID] and a.[Exam Urgency]=e.[Exam Urgency] and a.[Patient Type ID]=e.[Patient Type ID]

Select Year(a.[Request Date]) as year
  , Month(a.[Request Date]) as month
  , Datefromparts(Year(a.[Request Date]),Month(a.[Request Date]),01) as Date
  , Count(Distinct(a.[Exam Key])) as Clinical_Vetted
  ,a.[Vetting Code]
  ,c.[Trust Name Group2]
  ,d.[Referral Source]
  ,e.[Patient_Type], f.[Type] -- IRE100,IRE101,IRE110,IRE120,IRE130,IRE140,IRE141,IRE143,IRE200,IRE201,IRE210,IRE211,IRE220,IRE221,
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_VET] as A
  left join [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2] AS b on a.[Exam Key]=b.[Exam Key]
  left join [dev].[Trust Unique] AS c on b.[Trust ID]=c.[Trust ID]
  left join [dev].[Referral Source] AS d on b.[Referral Source ID]=d.[Referral Source ID]
  left join [dev].[Patient Type] AS e on b.[Patient Type ID]=e.[Patient Type ID]
  left join [dev].[staff] AS f on a.[userID]=f.[User ID]
  Group by Year(a.[Request Date]) , Month(a.[Request Date]) ,a.[Vetting Code],c.[Trust Name Group2],d.[Referral Source], e.[Patient_Type],f.[Type]

SELECT LEFT(a.Accession,3) as trust --IRE170
	  ,Month(a.[Status Date]) as Month
	  ,Year(a.[Status Date]) as Year
	  , Datefromparts(Year(a.[Status Date]),Month(a.[Status Date]),01) as Date
      ,Avg(DateDiff(day,Cast(convert(Date,[Status Date]) as datetime)+Cast(TIMEFROMPARTS(Convert(int,Left(format([Status Time],'0000'),2)),Convert(int,Right(format([Status Time],'0000'),2)),0,0,0) as datetime),b.[Status Date Time])) as [DateDiff]
	  ,d.[Patient_Type]
      FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_STATUSES] as a
  Inner join (SELECT [Exam Key]
      ,[Event Key]
      ,LEFT(Accession,3) as trust
      ,Max(Cast(convert(Date,[Status Date]) as datetime)+Cast(TIMEFROMPARTS(Convert(int,Left(format([Status Time],'0000'),2)),Convert(int,Right(format([Status Time],'0000'),2)),0,0,0) as datetime)) as [Status Date Time]
  FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_STATUSES]
 Where [Status Code] like ('V%')
 Group by [Exam Key]
      ,[Event Key],LEFT(Accession,3) ) as b on a.[Exam Key]=b.[Exam Key]
 left join [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2] AS c on a.[Exam Key]=c.[Exam Key]
 left join [dev].[Patient Type] AS d on c.[Patient Type ID]=d.[Patient Type ID]
 Where a.[Status Code] like ('RR')
 and DateDiff(day,a.[Status Date],b.[Status Date Time]) >=0 and a.[Status Date] > '12-31-2020'
Group by LEFT(a.Accession,3)
	  ,Month(a.[Status Date])
	  ,Year(a.[Status Date])
	  ,Datefromparts(Year(a.[Status Date]),Month(a.[Status Date]),01) 
	  ,d.[Patient_Type]

SELECT LEFT(a.Accession,3) as trust
	  ,Month(a.[Status Date]) as Month
	  ,Year(a.[Status Date]) as Year
	  , Datefromparts(Year(a.[Status Date]),Month(a.[Status Date]),01) as Date
	  ,d.[Patient_Type]
	  ,a.[Exam Key]
	  ,[Referral Source]
	  , a.[Status Code]
	  ,a.[Examination Name]
      FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_STATUSES] as a
 left join [dev].[FYF_ODBC_CORE_v2] AS c on a.[Exam Key]=c.[Exam Key]
 left join [dev].[Patient Type] AS d on c.[Patient Type ID]=d.[Patient Type ID]
 Where a.[Exam Key] in (Select [Exam Key] from (
SELECT [Exam Key]
            ,STRING_AGG([Examination Name] ,',') as [Examination Names]
  FROM (SELECT [Exam Key],[Examination Name]
             FROM [dev].[FYF_ODBC_STATUSES]
			  Where [Status Code] like ('V%') or [Status Code] like ('RR')
 and [Status Date] > '12-31-2020'
			 Group by [Exam Key],[Examination Name]
) as a1
  group by [Exam Key]) as b1 where [Examination Names] like '%,%')

Group by LEFT(a.Accession,3)
	  ,Month(a.[Status Date])
	  ,Year(a.[Status Date])
	  , Datefromparts(Year(a.[Status Date]),Month(a.[Status Date]),01)
	  ,d.[Patient_Type]
	  ,[Referral Source]
	  ,a.[Exam Key]
	  , a.[Status Code]
	  ,a.[Examination Name] 
	  Order by a.[Exam Key]	,Year(a.[Status Date])  ,Month(a.[Status Date])

SELECT [trust]
      ,[Month]
      ,[Year]
      ,[Date]
      ,[Patient_Type]
      ,[Exam Key]
      ,[Referral Source]
      ,[Examination Name]
	  ,ROW_NUMBER() Over (Partition by [trust]
      ,[Month]
      ,[Year]
      ,[Date]
      ,[Patient_Type]
      ,[Exam Key]
      ,[Referral Source]
	  order by [Examination Name]) as NUM
  FROM [dev].[irefer4]
  Where [Status Code] Like ('V%')
  Group by [trust]
      ,[Month]
      ,[Year]
      ,[Date]
      ,[Patient_Type]
      ,[Exam Key]
      ,[Referral Source]
      ,[Examination Name]

SELECT [year]
      ,[month]
      ,[Date]
      ,[Clinical_Vetted]
      ,[Vetting Code]
      ,[Trust Name Group]
      ,[Referral Source]
      ,[Patient_Type]
      ,[Type]
  FROM [dev].[iRefer2] as a
 left join dev.[Trust Unique] as b on a.[Trust Name Group2]=b.[Trust Name Group2] 
 Where [Trust Name Group]=LEFT([Referral Source],3)
